_note: An explainer in the demo.json format: a figure page recorded frame by frame, with captions timed to its marks. Run: node scripts/demo.mjs examples/explainer.demo.json (copy this file and the figure/ folder out of the skill first, into a folder that survives a restart). Everything here is made up: the build steps, the timings and the figure.
name: parallel-build

bench._timeline: Video seconds to figure time (figure seconds are build seconds, 0 to 223). Slow while the machines set up, quick through the long compile, slow again at each mark, then a hold on the finished bench.
bench._marks: The page has setup-done, checks-done, gate-open, serial-done and saved. These add caption-only marks (no anchor, so the camera ignores them) and keep the camera off checks-done, serial-done and saved: a mark here replaces the page's whole, so anchor and label are repeated.

scenes.text: Split the build across two machines
scenes.subtitle: The same steps, in turn or side by side

scenes._autoCamera: One lean-in, on the gate-open mark the callout uses. Deep enough (pad 2 lets the gate's box fill more of the view) that the view stays clear of the nameplates on the left and the stats and clock below.

captions.text: Each machine starts and installs first.
Lint, types and tests move to Parallel 2.
Serial only starts its compile at 1:15.
The compile lane sets the finish: 2:10.
From here on, every second is time saved.
The teal strip is the 1 m 30 s saved.

scenes.title: What the bench showed
items: 1 m 30 s saved on every build
